summary: Proxmox content is moving from community.general to the new community.proxmox collection, with deprecated redirects in community.general 11.0.0. You must install community.proxmox explicitly and update FQCNs. pipx make_process_list() is deprecated.
questions: Where are the proxmox modules moving?
Do I need to install community.proxmox separately?
How do I avoid proxmox deprecation warnings?

answer_card.title: Proxmox modules moving to community.proxmox
answer_card.answer_md:
Proxmox modules and plugins are moving to `community.proxmox`. From community.general 11.0.0 the old names are deprecated redirects.

```shell
ansible-galaxy collection install community.proxmox
```

Update your FQCNs, for example from `community.general.proxmox` to `community.proxmox.proxmox`, to avoid deprecation messages.
